focus_areas: Verification of missing 'scoop marks' via topology audit
Boundary definition between ice cream and pastry
Physics of melting and syrup flow
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'waxy' appearance of the central raspberry. In AI images, red fruits often lose their drupelet structure and become smooth blobs. Also, verify if the powdered sugar particles have individual definition or if they appear as a noisy blur, which is a common diffusion artifact. Crucially, use the Topology Auditor to determine if the smoothness of the ice cream is a result of melting (natural) or generative smoothing (artifact).
image_description: A close-up shot of a dessert featuring a scoop of white ice cream (likely vanilla or berry-swirl) sitting atop a golden-brown pastry base. The ice cream is garnished with fresh raspberries, mint leaves, and a dusting of powdered sugar. There are visible signs of melting on the ice cream surface and syrup drizzled over the pastry.
